title: Transforming From Immorality To Beautiful Civility Returning Our Kingdom To An Organized Nation Pt 3

sense.text:
“If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.” The qualification to lead the church of God, to lead the nation of Israel, is that your house has to be in order before anything else. You are no good as a leader if your house is in disruption and out of order.

This is why marriage is put first. From the beginning Satan attacked the marriage, the union of Adam and Eve, and from that came everything else: once Eve rebelled against her husband Adam, all hell broke loose. Every other sin is pyramiding from that pinnacle. To redeem the nation we have to go to the root, the union between husband and wife, or we will never get away from immorality and never reach civility. A strong marriage is a strong foundation for the building of a nation, and the camps out there in disarray, always on this doctrine of multiple hoes and all this madness, never teach about marriage.

“One that ruleth well his own house.” “For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?” All leadership, and all the civility we are trying to bring out, has to be built on that foundation.

There are many layers in that one verse. It is not only how the man guides and leads the house: the rebellion in the household symbolizes the rebellion of Israel against Christ, and that has to be brought into subjection.

“Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.” Satan attacked the marriage first, and this lets you know that you fall into the condemnation of the devil if that thing is out of order.

This is the message for the sisters who think they are going to get somewhere by leaving and messing up the Israelite man, as if there were salvation any other way. The man carries the seed, and that is where the Israelites are going to go through. A woman lies down with the other nations and she brings in the other nations; she is gone, she is done.

“For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee.” Full means completely. All of the places where we are serving captivity, we are looking at dead men walking. Even at the very end, the nations are going to be wiped out, and the only people on this planet at the final deal will be Israel. That is a level of power, but we are not to be arrogant with it, not yet. In the kingdom we shall boast; right now we need to be cool and do what we need to do to get out of it.

“Yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure.” That is where we are now, the stage of correction, because of the sin way back when we allowed our women to influence us: Adam and Eve. That brought down hardship, and we had to go through all kinds of struggles; we are trying to get back what we lost.

“And will not leave thee altogether unpunished.” We are getting judged. Our punishment, our trial, is our judgment: we are in the fire now. Marriages are in trouble now. Brothers are going through hell, and sisters are going through hell dealing with wicked brothers, because it goes both ways.

So there is a separation there. If you are Israel, you better stay with Israel and be glad you are part of this nation. Although it is rough, and sometimes we don’t like each other, you better stick it out, because if you are not on this train you will not exist much longer. We better learn how to get along right now, because we are not going to deal with that foolishness in the kingdom.

This is what morphed when the union of marriage, the way it was supposed to be, was destroyed. When that first marriage failed it brought on every ugliness you see right now: drug selling, rape, robberies, all of it running wild.

“The Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land”: he has a controversy with the Israelites. This is the northern kingdom, but Judah, the southern kingdom, was doing the same damn thing, worse. “Because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land”: the laws of God were not being kept. All of these things became evident when the first order of marriage was broken.

“By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery.” This is what is going on in these streets right now, right outside: killing, murdering, lying, raping, robbing, cheating. Why? Because we failed. The first marriage was allowed to fall, and that is Adam’s fault.

So it may appear that the finger is pointed at the women, but it is pointed at the brothers. The women will be slick and get on your nerves, but it is up to the man to say, I’m not hearing that, sit your behind down, we are going to do it this way. Once you entertain it, you bring in Satan, and that brought on all that is going on now. We have to look at ourselves while straightening them up; if they don’t want to get themselves together, goodbye.

Adultery is the big thing, and it can be looked at a couple of ways. A man may be home with his wife in body, but her mind is with Satan, with the other nations, with the white man or whoever she is entertaining; that is her lord in real truth, and she is just coming home to you. That is not the majority of us, nowhere near, but when it comes out in a judgment it is mind-boggling. These are heavy situations that we as men must take on and fix.

“Except the Lord build the house”: the house of Israel. Except the Lord build it on God’s principles, on God’s divine order, on God’s structure, “they labour in vain that build it.” There is no other foundation than Christ, and many of us still do not embrace that fully; the things we are partial to and make excuses for, we still try to build with. We still look at marriage, even in IUIC, through the lens of how the world taught us marriage. Brothers say three years of proving before marrying is a lot, yet in the world, so long as they were getting the milk right from the cow, they waited seven, eight, nine, ten years to marry the sister. Three years is only too long because of what you want.

“Except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.” It is all vanity, because it is not going to be successful. If it is built on the doctrines of men and what your feelings are, and not on what God has established, it will not stand.

“It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows.” All this gross darkness we are still in: if you don’t build the house the way the Lord intended, starting with marriage and its structure and the children that come from it, it is vain, and you are eating the bread of sorrows.

“Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.” That does not mean all children: not children of unclean marriages, not children of marriages that are not built and established by two believers moving in the right spirit. A husband and wife that agree together are pleasant in his eyes.

“As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth. Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed.” When the marriage is built the way the Lord intended, you will not be ashamed of your children.

“But they shall speak with the enemies in the gate”: they are going to carry on the building and follow in the footsteps of their father. Everybody likes to quote the avengers, but your avenger is not here until you raise him up the way these verses say. The heritage is that we continue to build God’s house the way the Lord intended, not the way we intend. This is the good side; it is why marriage keeps having to come up, because it is the foundation of all these things.

“Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord.” When the brothers are out on the street teaching, that is what we teach our brothers and sisters: come out of the sinful lives you are living in, out of Babylon the great, out of these wicked holidays, out of crime and drugs.

But if we are telling them to come out of something, what are we telling them to say yes to? There has to be something for them to receive in order for them to let go of the evils: we bring them in to righteously enjoy the commandments of the Lord through the high holy days, and that gets their mind off what Babylon tricked them into. They have to lose their wicked parents, wicked friends and all of that to gain something when they come in. An organized nation thinks on all of these points; there are many facets to the nation of Israel, and we have to deal with the nation holistically.

“And touch not the unclean thing”: don’t touch those unclean customs. Separate yourselves from the ugliness that sends us down the path of total destruction. When the brothers go out to war fighting the evil spirits to resurrect our nation, they cannot come home to foolishness and craziness, or they will not be able to continue the work.

“And I will receive you.” When you come into IUIC there are brothers and sisters, men and women, the whole nation, looking to help you along your righteous path to the Most High into repentance.

“And will be a Father unto you.” Your fathers out there did not teach you anything; your mothers out there did not teach you anything. You were lost, but now you are found. Welcome home.

“And ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.” You are not abandoned, not left out in the cold. Now we have belonging, now we are loved, now we are wrapped in the Most High’s care. That makes you stand up with pride and esteem and say, I will not allow mediocrity and BS to deter me from this righteous path, because now my Father has me, my nation has me, my elder mothers, my elder brothers, all the sisters and brothers. That is a family we all need.

So many of these sisters don’t have fathers, and many of these brothers don’t have fathers and mothers; some were ripped right off the street, and we have to rehabilitate them with the Bible. When they come in they gain fathers and mothers who stand in their place and guide them, so that at the marriage we can look over and say all of these mothers made sure this sister grew up right, and all of these fathers made sure this brother came out right. When you get married that continues, because you provide it for your children: the beginning of righteousness going from you all the way down through your generations.

precepts.why: “Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder.” When our brothers and sisters come in, they are going to have to submit to the leadership. That is how the Lord gives them fathers and mothers in this truth.

“The elder women as mothers.” The mothers out there didn’t teach anything, the daughters ran wild, the sons ran wild, and daddies weren’t teaching nothing. But they heard the prophets say, come out of that. So the elder women become mothers to the sisters out there who don’t have proper guidance. That is the importance of you elders.

Sometimes the children come in first, get themselves fixed up and go back home to that sinful family, and the parents notice the righteous change and ask the reason of the hope that is in them: what is this new beautiful spirit, this respect for me when I have been nothing but a bad father, a bad mother? The children say, I learned it at IUIC, and then the parents can come in and become repentant mothers and fathers.

“The younger as sisters, with all purity.” The younger women will be sisters to the disenfranchised sisters coming in. When a sister comes in, she doesn’t know how to put a skirt on, dress properly, carry herself or have a righteous conversation; she learns from sisters who were guided by proper mothers and fathers in the body. The brothers are the same: we can be a proper influence on the brothers who came in from total dysfunction outside. We have a real job ahead of us.

That is why we thank the Lord for the sisters who have repented and hold on to righteousness: they are going up against the trajectory Satan set for them. Continue to work together, not apart.

sense.text:
“Marriage is honourable in all.” A lot of people read that and keep going, but in all means everything. When marriage is done right, it is honorable in all things: there is no lying, cheating, adultery, none of what we read in Hosea 4. And when the marriage is done right, you don’t prove too quick; you make sure your mind and your spouse’s mind are on the mind of God. What God has joined together, let no man put asunder. It is a lifetime commitment, and there is no second time around; it is supposed to be done right the first time. If Adam and Eve had done it right, we would never have seen any of this garbage. It would have been paradise, and we have the chance to bring that back.

“And the bed undefiled.” In righteousness the man and the woman can get in the bed and it is undefiled, because it is according to God; it is okay with God, and there is no shame, no sneaking around like with adultery and fornication. It is a shame that it even has to be specified that it is a man and a woman, not two men; that filth came because the marriage was messed up from the beginning. God is with that union, and he will bring righteous children from it.

That is why there is jubilee when a brother stands up with his wife and says, we are expecting. Out in the world, sisters are afraid when they get pregnant, because everybody looks down on them and asks where the father is. When it is our people on the labor floor, notes come down: don’t send him up here; he’s the damn father, meanwhile the damn boyfriend is up there. Then the father says, I heard that a nigga’s up there, and there is a damn fight on the damn labor floor. The baby is brought into complete chaos; mothers carry the baby by themselves with nobody to sign the paperwork; a man asks where he can get the pill to kill the baby. Esau’s families fill the lobby waiting for pictures and erupt with joy when the baby is born. We have lost that. When the marriage is done right, the child comes into the world welcomed instead of hated.

“But whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.” Here is where everything goes off the rails; this is the lying, stealing, killing and adultery read in Hosea. The man and the woman in fornication and adultery, lying to their spouses and everyone around them to hide this evil: the Lord says, I am going to find you and judge you. That is why the world outside is in total chaos, and some of it is trying to creep in here. The leadership has to be the vanguard, with the scriptures as spiritual guns, to correct that errant behavior until you get your mind right, or you have to permanently go.

precepts.why:
Psalms 127 is the good side: the children of a house the Lord builds are like arrows in a quiver, speaking with the enemies in the gate. This is the bad side, what comes up when things are not done properly.

“For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.” In Hebrews, when it is done right, the bed is undefiled. This is an unlawful bed, a bed of wickedness: they were not supposed to be in a bed together at all. They got together in the heat of the night, and children came of it. This is what is going on outside, and in some marriages: very few, but enough to make you sick, a woman leaving a righteous marriage, her husband doing all he can, to play with the man in the street and get pregnant by him.

Those illicit children are the evidence of the illicit union. There is no hiding it; the child tells on the parents, and the child can look back and say, you produced me. The children are witnesses against the wicked parents, destined for hardship, and that is why their lives are so messed up: God judged the parents by cursing that child, because the parents didn’t have enough sense to do it right.

But here is the difference. Those outside who don’t know will get more mercy, because they don’t know what we know. They come in on drugs, with a mama and daddy who were no good, not even knowing why their self-esteem is on the floor or why they hate themselves, and the doors are open to them: all sin can be forgiven, and even the parents who didn’t know can come in and get themselves straight. But those of us in here who know better cannot make that mistake. And brothers, cool your heels when such sisters come in; they just went through hell, and they need time, three years, to get themselves together.

sense.text:
“And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth. And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?” The disciples were asking Christ about something Christ had taught them: the regeneration, when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory. How could the man commit the sin he was paying for with blindness from birth, if he was not on this earth before? That is proof we have been here before.

Christ did not say, what are you talking about, or that they were bugging out for asking. He answered it.

“Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest.” In this case the man was not born blind because he played with it; the Most High caused him to be born blind so that he could be healed later. The Lord may allow situations to happen anywhere, even in here, so that he can exercise his mercy and his power on them as an example to the rest of us; people may have needed to see that Christ could heal those sicknesses. The Lord has people’s lives plotted out for what he needs them to be.

But that is not an excuse to do the evil. Don’t be so confident in it that you go out and play with the Most High’s judgment, because you might never even make it in here. We in here know better.

precepts.why:
The children do pay for the sins of their fathers, because they are their fathers come back. “Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity”: the Pharisees were wicked as hell. “Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous”: they killed the prophets, murdering the Israelites who came to teach Christ’s gospel to the Israelites.

“And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.” Someone might say the Pharisees were not literally going around killing the prophets of old. The Pharisees said it themselves: that wasn’t us; if it had been us back there, we would not have done that.

“Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.” They came back generations later proclaiming to be righteous, but they were the ones doing the killing back then. “Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers”: reap what you sow; it is time for you to pay for what you did.

“And that will by no means clear the guilty”: the guilty were those who killed the prophets. “Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children”: the murder of the prophets visited upon the children, who were the Pharisees at that point, “and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.” That is what Christ meant by fill ye up the measure of your fathers: they were their fathers, doing the killing back then.

Those who led us into captivity on the slave ships have not gone into captivity yet, but they are going; they have to fill up the measure of their fathers. And we had to fill up the measure of ours. When Moses spoke to us on the mount and said the Lord would bring us into Egypt again with ships, the people standing in front of him did not go on ships. Generations later those same spirits came back and literally went. Moses was speaking to them; it was time to go on those ships, because they were there in front of Moses generations ago.

sense.text:
“Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?” This is what we want, brothers, and you sisters should want it too: to return our kingdom to an organized nation. Even then the apostles were looking for the return of the kingdom. But it is not going to be returned unless the man is in his proper order. The Most High is not going to give the kingdom to the women and not the men; the only way you are going to get your salvation is through your man. This is a question for us as men: we want our kingdom back.

The so-called white woman, with the Vogue magazines and Miss America and how other women worship her, would have none of that if she did not support her man; her man had to guarantee her sovereignty, her safety and her ability to prance around. That same man has his woman in check, then gets into our women and tells them they don’t need the brothers, and they think they are going to go off with him. But the Lord is going to make a full end of everybody, and where will you be?

That it is offensive to some of our sisters is bananas, and the fact that it even has to be addressed is evidence of our destruction; no other nation does it. Their women want their men to protect them and get the spoils. Some sisters don’t have confidence that the brothers are going to get it together, so they go where they think it will be permanent; but it will not be permanent. You are not going to get past this brother, because you came from the brother. There would be no need for a charger if the phone wasn’t here: the charger came out of the phone, and the woman came out of man. That is why she is called woman, because she was taken out of man. She is to be a helpmate and a comfort to him, so that he can guarantee her protection and the offspring that come from her.

precepts.why:
Some sisters have the screw face: what do you mean the man, I love Jesus directly. There is no glory for the sisters unless the men get their glory, and none of it comes to pass unless the men get their glory as prophesied. That is why the charging stations need to be at full force.

“For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church”: it is the same thing. There is no salvation except through Christ. “And he is the saviour of the body”: the man is the saviour of the body. That is the saviours on mount Zion: the flock of the pasture is men.

It does not make sense in any society for it to be otherwise. All women expect their men to guarantee their protection; the women of the white movements were behind their men a thousand percent, even in evil and wickedness, going out to the lynchings to support them. But our women let the wickedness seep in; Satan still has a place in their head.

sense.text:
“The kingdom of heaven”: the kingdom of heaven is the nation of Israel. That is what the apostles were asking in Acts, will thou restore the kingdom to Israel, because that is where the kingdom is; the kingdom belongs with us. People think the other nations can be a part of the kingdom of heaven, but the kingdom of heaven is the Israelites. The kingdom is what the Lord puts in us to organize; then he will back it up with his angels, and we will literally take the kingdom like the scriptures say. But it has to be dealt with in us first, as men, in strict obedience to God’s commandments.

“From the days of John the Baptist until now”: between John the Baptist coming on the scene and the time it was spoken, “the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.” The violent are the Romans, who took the kingdom away from us by force. We were the kingdom, but we lost it. Part of the kingdom of heaven is being able to envision your nation and lay down its foundations, because it is going to be right here on this earth, not floating around with wings; having your nation, your children and your women in order is the foretelling of the kingdom. Christ and the angels will come and give it to us with power, but our mind has to be ready, so we need to be rehearsing it now. Our enemies understood that, so they intercepted our ability to be a nation.

By force: that is how they took away our sovereignty. The Willie Lynch letter is the same program, the same doctrine used to keep us enslaved since the beginning of our captivities; whether Willie Lynch was real or a pseudonym, what was written was real, and we have lived it. When we lost our women, we lost the charging station, the pillar of rest, the comfort, the solace, the other half. A man warring and warring with no build-back will fail. They seriously took the kingdom when they separated our women from us, which is exactly what happened with Adam and Eve.

Violence was done to the nation of Israel beyond what most of us think when we read this: eventually our women were taken from us. Once you have lost the women, you have lost the mothers who could properly guide your children, and your generations are done. When you break up a man’s family you take away his support, his legs, his pillar of strength, his comfort, his solace, his reverence, his cheerleading, and give them to the enemy, who enjoys your woman at your demise and puts her in videos. That is a slap in every man’s face. We think of the violence as them cutting up our babies and killing us left and right when they came into Jerusalem, but the violence continued for generations down the line.

The breaking process: take the female and test her to see if she will submit willingly. It took time, because at first she was paired with a husband and that union had to be broken; just as it took time for Satan to get Eve to come away from Adam, and just as the work husband comes little by little, a smile at the water cooler, a little compliment, until you don’t recognize your wife. She is the most important factor for good economics, because she is where his strength and his stability are. Take his woman from him and he walks up and down mourning. They looked for any glimmer of honor to her husband to whip out of her, until she was totally disconnected and against her husband’s will, and then she would train her offspring to submit: the children are the economics. That is slavery: once they have your mind they can make slaves of her children, put them on the football field and pay them a little bit of money. The King Leopold letter says the same. They knew already that to kill, to sleep with someone else’s wife, to lie and to insult is bad, the commandments still in us, so the missionaries were to take that away: take away their Bible and give them Christianity, which has nothing to do with the Bible at all, and separate them from the riches under their own feet, the global robbery still going on with the oil. Teach the children to obey the missionary instead of their parents, the white man as the father of their soul, teach them to read and not to reason, so they stay in submission and never revolt against the restraints, the mental and psychological restraints, reciting to them every day that the kingdom of God is for those who weep. That is still happening today, to our northern kingdom brothers in the islands and right here, wherever the Israelites are scattered.

So she has been totally separated from us. That is the violence: once they took her away and turned her inside out, we lost connection with her, and that is why there is such contempt and hatred in some of these marriages. This is the fight.

“And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come”: the same question the brothers asked in Acts. This is a message to us men. “He answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation.” We look for it to come from somewhere out there, because we tend to externalize everything and not take what is in us. The Lord put a mind and a spirit in us to build and to organize; we were made after the image of our Father.

“Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.” It is within your mind. Because I made you in my image, I made you to think like me and to create things.

Everything you lay your eyes on, outside of the ground, the vegetation and the water that were here, came from a thought. When IUIC says it will build buildings and do different things, people say somebody must have sold out, because they cannot believe we can envision things in our mind and bring them into existence. That is because their brain is dead, but you are supposed to think like your Father. We can materialize filthy thoughts that become filthy words, filthy actions, filthy character and a filthy destiny; why can’t we materialize righteousness with that same brain? The Bible gives us the keys to the kingdom, organized under Christ’s commandments, to build the city that sits on the hill that is in your mind. We have to do the work to materialize those thoughts. That is how we restore the kingdom back to us.

precepts.why:
“In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. And the earth was without form and void.” The earth was not even in physical existence yet, but it still existed in God’s mind: if you are going to call it earth, it existed, and where did it exist? In God’s mind. “And darkness was upon the face of the deep”: the deep is the elements God used to fashion the earth. It had to exist in his mind first, and he manipulated the elements to bring them into the form of what was in his mind. “And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters”: upon the elements.

“And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.” God imagined what light should be. “And God saw the light, that it was good”: when he created the light, he compared it to the image in his mind, and it was good, meaning, I can stop, because it conforms to my thoughts. He did the same with the earth: when it was all done, it was good, because it conformed to the image of the earth he had in his mind before it was created.

So when the Lord said we are made in his image, we have the ability to do the same thing: to organize and put things together in our mind before they become physical. That is what Christ is saying in Luke. You don’t have to look out there; it is in your mind, if you just discipline yourselves and bring it forward.

sense.text:
“But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.” That was the problem right there. Satan told Eve that the day she listened to him her eyes would be opened and she would be just like her husband: Adam was already a god, and she could be a god like him. The temptation was her being able to be over her husband. Under Adam, Eve thought she was Adam’s equal, and he had to correct that BS.

That is why the Lord came back and said Adam shall rule over her: she was already separated from him.
“For Adam was first formed, then Eve.” It goes right back to Adam: she came out of Adam.

“And Adam was not deceived.” Satan could not come to Adam, because he was already a god, made lord of all the creatures, as the Apocrypha says. Eve was supposed to be his comfort, his aid, his charger. “But the woman being deceived was in the transgression”: the transgression was that she listened to Satan to overthrow her husband. Rome is doing the same thing today, using our women against us for their benefit, as Eve was used for Satan’s benefit.

“Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.” If they continue in the faith of obeying her husband, because that is the way God set it up. With sobriety: don’t be crazy, listening to some foolish Dr. Buzzard stuff telling you to be against your husband. That is out of order. The Most High gave the woman labor pains as a remembrance of her place under her husband.

And to ask why we have to be under him: no other woman does this. When a thief comes to break into the house, do you want to be the first one to deal with him, or do you want the man to come to the door with the stuff? It would be horrible to see a man jump behind his woman and push her in front of him. So sisters, be under that man in righteousness.

precepts.why:
“A woman that honoureth her husband shall be judged wise of all.” This is your wisdom, sisters: honor the husband, with all the layers that have been brought out. “But she that dishonoureth him in her pride shall be counted ungodly of all”: because that is pride, to say, damn, I got to be under a man, he the saviour of the body? I got a direct line to Jesus.

“A dishonest woman contemneth shame: but an honest woman will reverence her husband.” It is shameful if you don’t go into the divine order the way the Lord wants the house built. Reverence is beyond respect: a feeling or attitude of deep respect, tinged with awe and veneration. That is your man up on a pedestal; he is Superman to you, and when he walks in the house everything gets still to welcome him home. The women understand it, because they do it when they go to work, for the boss who gives them their paycheck; this is how it should be when he comes home. Reverence is also the outward manifestation of that feeling: there are actions behind it, not excuses about a hard day. If the definition is hard to understand, read the opposite and don’t do that: contempt, reproach. If there is a tinge of contempt in your spirit towards your husband, that is not reverence.

“A shameless woman shall be counted as a dog”: and we know what female dogs are called. “But she that is shamefaced will fear the Lord.” When they hear fear the Lord they think, I love Jesus, I’m married to Jesus; but the woman who honors her husband is the one who fears the Lord, and she is judged wise of all, while she who dishonors him in her pride is counted ungodly of all.

There was a marriage in the congregation where contempt was shown: that brother felt none of the deep respect, awe and veneration. He felt contempt.

sense.text:
“Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself.” When a man knows his wife is his comfort, that she will charge his batteries, he will put his life on the line for her; he will kill for that. When you love your wife, your family and your nation, you go to war to protect it. If I love my wife as I love myself, I am not going to let anybody do harm to her, or to my sons and daughters. Any animal will fight for what is vital to its survival; any man who will just let somebody run over him is a damn fool. There is a time when you might have to put your life on the line, so be ready.

“And the wife see that she reverence her husband.” This is her part: what she must do to make sure he is willing to put his life on the line. The influence of the woman is what causes her husband to jump down in a lion pit, go to war and bring back the spoils. If she is right, the brother will put his life on the line to protect her. He is not going to put his life on the line if he is not getting what is read here. A man standing at the door with the stuff, knowing he has a wife who reverences him, with deep respect tinged with awe and veneration, how she esteems and honors him: you are not taking that away, over my dead body. But when you don’t have that, you have contempt and reproach: here are the keys, go in there.

Satan uses the women of Esau to lead our women. They took our women by force and gave them white mothers, where we are supposed to be mothers to our sisters outside, so our women follow their example, envying the oppressor: they sat on the train reading Harlequin novels about the white woman and the white man in love, then came home and tried to practice those methods on their husbands. Whatever these women say, many of our women follow: the white woman on social media telling women to wish their husbands would cheat so they can leave and rebrand themselves, withholding sex until he falters, monitoring his texts, waiting to bust him and take his pension. That is contempt, the feeling that a person is beneath consideration, worthless, deserving scorn. Some brothers live with that; they can feel the rejection, they can feel that she hates them, that her mind is not there even in the bed. A brother in the congregation endured that abuse for the children’s sake, being a righteous father to another man’s children, and when the evidence came forward he said, that’s it; that was not a weak brother. They give the veneration to the boss at work, and the husband at home gets nothing, and the Lord is not going to bless that at all. That is a narcissist demon, out to bring a good man down and make him look like a fool in front of everyone. She pushes him to the limits of his morality until he goes looking for solace and comfort he never really wanted; then she points the finger, rebrands herself, takes his annuity and his pension in court, and the man loses every damn thing.

This is why the proving process must be done right, so we don’t have these problems: it is an investment for your life and your children, not just your genitals. And there is no divorce in it; getting a divorce is not scriptural.

Many sisters, and brothers too, kick against the pricks in their marriage: God set forth the ordained order of the man and the woman, the woman kicks against it, and when the issues come she blames the man, without putting in the proper effort in her divine order.

“But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations”: their own mindset of how they deem marriage, according to the world and not according to God. “Which have neglected the righteous”: this man is putting forth his best effort to be a righteous man, fixing himself and getting himself together, and she neglects him. “And forsaken the Lord”: by doing that she forsakes the Lord, because in order for a woman to fear the Lord she must honor her husband, and she says, I’m not doing none of that.

“For whoso despiseth wisdom and nurture”: she despises God’s wisdom and the nurture that comes from that wisdom, so “he is miserable.” Now your life is miserable, and you complain about your marriage. A sister commented that marriage seems miserable in the Israelite community, like the women are slaves. These women are not slaves; you just don’t want to come under the wisdom and nurture of God, you want to do your own thing according to the world.

“And their hope is vain, their labours unfruitful, and their works unprofitable”: the things you are trying to bring forth, your connection in marriage, your jobs, your business with your husband, none of it works.

“Their wives are foolish, and their children wicked”: you bring forth wicked children.

This cannot be left on the back burner. All of the great works that men and women seek to do will falter at some level, and will not have the potency they should have in going for the kingdom, if this problem with marriage is not fixed. Some brothers are not married at all and do well to a degree, without the distraction, as Paul said, but not everybody has that strength; most of the time brothers need that comfort, that solace.

This is not a marriage topic alone: marriage is the foundation of what builds our people as a strong nation. Except the Lord build the house, it is all vanity. Everybody should be examining themselves, especially you sisters: don’t presume you have it right. In the circles, many are going through this and not saying anything, and when it comes out it is a bomb that drops instead of being dealt with at the level it needs to be. Some sisters tried to use the unbelieving departing as a way out, withholding sex to drive the husband away; but there are men who try to wait the woman out the same way, and that is evil as hell too.

The sisters need to examine themselves in reverence and get in line, but brothers, we are the ones with the preeminence to make that thing happen. “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel.” Nobody understands what it means to give honor as unto the weaker vessel. The women think it means, give me mercy, I’m the weaker vessel, let me mess up, and some men think the same. That is not what it is.

precepts.why: This is one portion of what it means to dwell with them according to knowledge and give honor as unto the weaker vessel. “That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel”: first that is talking about you; your body is your vessel, and you need to know how to possess it. When you get a wife, you take possession, so now you possess her vessel too, because the woman came from man: his vessel is his body and her body. “In sanctification and honour”: in cleansing, sanctification and honor.

Christ sanctifies the church and presents it to himself, and so the husband does the wife: “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing.”

So the husband cannot do like Adam and say, it was the woman you gave me. You had choices, and proving processes that should have been done properly, with the right time constraints. Once she is yours there is no divorce; you are in it. You can either be happy and function the way the Lord says, or remember that the man will give you the version of himself he needs to survive. David did not divorce Michal, but he never touched her again: that was it, dry up. A man can tolerate that much longer than a woman can. We should not be bitter or in contempt; we have to build that thing up.
